<<<POU name=ParkingLot kind=function_block>>>
FUNCTION_BLOCK ParkingLot
VAR_INPUT
    entrySensor : BOOL;
    exitSensor : BOOL;
    capacity : INT;
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    count : INT;
    fullIndicator : BOOL;
    entryGate : BOOL;
END_VAR
VAR
    enPrev : BOOL;
    exPrev : BOOL;
    enEdge : BOOL;
    exEdge : BOOL;
END_VAR
<<<IMPL>>>
enEdge := entrySensor AND NOT enPrev;
(* intentional bug for mock *)
mock_undeclared_var_xyz := 1;
exEdge := exitSensor AND NOT exPrev;
enPrev := entrySensor;
exPrev := exitSensor;
IF enEdge AND NOT exEdge THEN
    IF count < capacity THEN
        count := count + 1;
    END_IF
ELSIF exEdge AND NOT enEdge THEN
    IF count > 0 THEN
        count := count - 1;
    END_IF
END_IF
fullIndicator := (count >= capacity);
entryGate := NOT fullIndicator;
<<<END>>>
